title: Manifest
description: The whole manifest. `generate` writes it, and `check` reads it.

$schema.description: The file name of the JSON Schema of this manifest.

network_passphrase.description: The passphrase of the network that signed and closed the ledgers.

sources.description: The sources: one XDR value each.

entries.description: The entries: one rare shape each.

Source.description: One XDR value in the files `<id>.xdr` and `<id>.json`.

id.description: The name of the source and of its two files.

xdr_type.description: The XDR type of the value.

Origin.description: Where the bytes of a source come from.

oneOf.description: A local stellar-core closed the ledger.

ledger_protocol.description: The protocol under which the ledger closed.

oneOf.description: The generator built the bytes, and stellar-core did not emit them.

Entry.description: One rare shape: a place in a source.

description.description: The fact that a reader of the shape must keep.

caps.description: The CAPs that introduced the shape, ascending. The list is empty for a shape that the network had at launch.

since_protocol.description: The first protocol under which the network can emit the shape, 0 for a shape that the network had at launch.

xdr_type.description: The XDR type of the shape.

soroban_validity.description: What the Soroban host answers about the shape.

location.description: The place of the shape in a source.

sightings.description: The upstream issues and pull requests where the shape broke a reader.

SorobanValidity.description: What the Soroban host, the engine that stellar-core runs, answers about a value.

oneOf.description: The host refuses the value. stellar-core can still write it to a ledger, for example as the argument of a call that fails.
The value is not a Soroban value, so the host has no answer.

Location.description: The place of a shape, written in two ways.

json_pointer.description: A JSON Pointer into the decoded source, empty for the whole value.

byte_range.description: The same place in the bytes of the source.

ByteRange.description: A range of the bytes of a source: `length` bytes from `offset`.
